description: Stonehaven has designed and built gardens across Bedford and the surrounding hamlets of Pound Ridge, Katonah, and Mount Kisco since the studio opened. Our crews work weekly across the area; site visits are typically same-week.
Backcountry estates, Round Hill, Riverside, Belle Haven — we've built across Greenwich for over a decade. Daniel keeps a build crew based out of Stamford for projects in the area.
Mid-century modern landscapes are some of our most rewarding work. New Canaan's modernist heritage calls for restrained planting and exact stonework — a discipline we welcome.
From coastal properties on Compo Beach to wooded sites further inland, Westport projects often combine native plantings with custom hardscape and discreet site lighting.
Historic Litchfield properties demand restraint. We've restored stone walls dating to the 1780s and designed kitchen gardens that look like they've been tended for generations.
Our studio sits on Warren Street. We work extensively across Columbia County — from working farms to in-town gardens — and our crews are within thirty minutes of most sites.
Rhinebeck and the surrounding Dutchess County estates have been a regular part of our portfolio since 2014. Many of our larger naturalistic plantings live here.
A select number of Princeton-area projects each year. Travel is built into the engagement and our build crews stage out of a Bucks County, PA yard for the season.
